metadata.source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Data Profiles & Bergen County 2026 Certified Rolls

zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Radburn Historic Planned Community, River Road & West District, Memorial Park & Berdan Grove, Warren Point & Eastern Border
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 3.512%, with an equalization ratio of 68.2%.
Public education represents 64.5% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 25.1%.
Average residential assessment is $416,020, producing an average annual tax bill of $14,610.62.

neighborhoods.name: Radburn Historic Planned Community
neighborhoods.character: World-famous 'Town for the Motor Age' with pedestrian park networks, interior walking paths, and historic colonial residences
neighborhoods.description: National Historic Landmark community designed in 1929 by Clarence Stein and Henry Wright, separating foot traffic from roadways with extensive parklands.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Homeowners pay private Radburn Association dues in addition to standard Fair Lawn property taxes.

neighborhoods.name: River Road & West District
neighborhoods.character: Suburban single-family homes and cape cods adjacent to River Road commercial district and Passaic River parklands
neighborhoods.description: Core residential family neighborhood convenient to River Road shopping, Memorial Park, and NJ Transit Radburn rail station.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Benefited from Fair Lawn's commercial tax base (Nabisco site redevelopment and Route 208 corporate corridor).

neighborhoods.name: Memorial Park & Berdan Grove
neighborhoods.character: Spacious suburban neighborhood featuring quiet residential streets, mature shade trees, and community ballfields
neighborhoods.description: Established post-war suburban neighborhood offering access to Berdan Grove Park and Fair Lawn High School campus.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Predictable residential property assessment roll with stable effective tax rate (~2.28%).

neighborhoods.name: Warren Point & Eastern Border
neighborhoods.character: Neighborhood bordering Elmwood Park and Saddle Brook, featuring well-maintained ranches, cape cods, and quiet streets
neighborhoods.description: Accessible neighborhood convenient to Broadway bus lines, local parks, and Warren Point Elementary School.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Moderate assessment bracket providing an entry point for first-time North Jersey homebuyers.

equityAnalysis.summary: Fair Lawn Borough maintains a certified residential tax roll across its neighborhoods.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Fair Lawn Borough, homeowners pay an average of $14,610.62 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 10.89% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 68.2%, assessed values average ~68.2% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 64.5% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 25.1%, and Bergen County claims 10.4%.
